WebGPU runtimes for Liquid AI's LFM3 models, copied from languel/seloai (public/vendor/).

Lfm3ForCausalLM.js: a WebGPU inference runtime for LFM3 text models (GGUF).
  Source: https://huggingface.co/spaces/webml-community/LFM3-1.7B-WebGPU-Pi
  (dist/runtime/Lfm3ForCausalLM.js). Licence of the Space: Apache-2.0.
  Includes Hugging Face tokenization and Jinja templating.

Lfm3OmniForConditionalGeneration.js: the same runtime family for LFM3-Omni
  (text, speech in and speech out), from the webml-community WebGPU builds,
  as used in seloai.

Weights are not bundled: they download on first use from Hugging Face
(LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B-GGUF, LiquidAI/LFM3-Omni-2B-GGUF) and remain subject to
their repositories' terms (the LFM Open License).
